content: In this paper, we first look at related work ($§$SECREF2), then study $\mathit {\texttt {-}PMI}$ and ways of accounting for it ($§$SECREF3), describe experiments ($§$SECREF4), analyze results ($§$SECREF5), and close with ideas for future work ($§$SECREF6).
